rationale: Rejected as submitted: operative_clauses[0].first_end.date and whole_order_end.date assert 1906-02-12, and research_rationale asserts a one-month administrative wind-down. The complete visually inspected printed page 67 (PDF page 80), signed Theodore Roosevelt and dated The White House, January 12, 1906, supplies no delay, duration, wind-down, administrative completion event or future performance condition. Its sole operative sentence says that the Executive Order of November 15, 1905 concerning appointments in the Isthmian Canal Commission service upon the Isthmus of Panama is hereby repealed. This is a present legal transition effected by the instrument itself. The supported first exhaustion of that sole command is January 12, 1906, rather than an inferred later implementation date. The card itself inconsistently explains in judgment_reason that completion occurred on January 12. That accurate explanation cannot cure the exact contrary date assertions being reviewed.

operative_inventory.description: One immediate repeal of the November 15, 1905 appointment order. Date and signature are present. No schedule, implementation command, report, appointment, removal, repayment, future deadline or express savings appears.
operative_inventory.identity: The page prints no EO number. Permitted IC1911_WPA_LORD_MATCH.csv entry 35 maps the January 12, 1906 repeal subject to EO:393; IC1911_ORDERS.csv maps that identity to PDF page 80 / printed page 67. Identity metadata alone was used, not its status fields.

effective_date_and_first_cessation.basis: The dated instrument itself immediately performs the repeal; no future act is required to accomplish its stated legal transition.
effective_date_and_first_cessation.earlier_candidates: Issuance on January 12 is an earlier and directly supported cessation candidate omitted from the asserted end dates. No pre-issuance cessation of this instrument is supported. November 15, 1905 dates the target order, not this order or its cessation.
effective_date_and_first_cessation.formal_disposition: No later formal revocation of EO393 is established or needed to show exhaustion of this sole self-executing command.

savings_and_residuals: The accomplished cancellation can have enduring consequences without creating a continuing EO393 command. No express savings or independent prospective duty is printed. The source does not itself order cancellation of prior appointments or extinguish rights under other instruments; neither such effects nor any administrative performance are assumed. The broad no-operative-force-at-cutoff conclusion is consistent with exhaustion, but the exact submitted date and duration are unsupported.
bounded_search_limitations: No network or independent later-source corpus search was performed. The card describes bounded current-law and later-event machine searches, including incomplete temporal and citation coverage; those descriptions were not independently rerun or treated as proof of absence. Later revival or separate rights under other instruments were not established. Rejection rests on the exact original source and unsupported month-long duration, not on search silence.
